raw_html: [[Transmuted Platinum|Transmuted Platinum (Epic)]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Transmuted Platinum|Transmuted Platinum (Epic)]]''': This weapon, made of transmuted platinum, is slightly magically unstable, and has a chance to transfer its magic to those it strikes. Struck enemies have a small chance to turn into transmuted platinum, preventing all movement, with a DC of 70 negating this effect.
